question.text: Let <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>S</mi></math> be the set of all <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>a</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>N</mi></math> such that the area of the triangle formed by the tangent at the point <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>P</mi><mfenced><mrow><mi>b</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>c</mi></mrow></mfenced><mo>,</mo><mi>b</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>c</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>N</mi></math>,  on the parabola <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>y</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>a</mi><mi>x</mi></math> and the lines <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>b</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>16</mn><msup><mi>unit</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></math>, then <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><munder><mo>∑</mo><mrow><mi>a</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>S</mi></mrow></munder><mi>a</mi></math> is equal to _____ .

solution.text:
Given,

S be the set of all a∈N such that the area of the triangle formed by the tangent at the point Pb,c, b, c∈N,  on the parabola y2=2ax

And the lines x=b,y=0 is 16unit2

Now plotting the diagram we get,

 

Tangent at Pb,c will be ax-cy+ab=0 and it meets x-axis at -b,0

Now area of triangle PAB=122bc=16⇒bc=16

So, b,c=1,16,2,8,4,4,8,2,16,1 as both belongs to natural number,

Now b,c lie on parabola hence satisfy it

c2=2ab⇒c2=2a16c⇒a=c332

Now when possible value of c is c=4,8,16⇒a=2,16,128

Hence, ∑a∈Sa=2+16+128=146.
